STG - 44 | Sturmgewehr
Creator: Max Ilin / ELIZION
Original publication: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/stg-44-sturmgewehr-fa37bef729e141a6a29bb022a3e0be41
Creator portfolio: https://elizion.artstation.com/projects/aYYBaL
Original publication date: 7 November 2020 (Sketchfab listing)
Download date: 26 September 2026
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License deed: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
License legal code: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode

Changes: The original FBX meshes and five PBR texture sets were imported into
an isolated Blender working file. Albedo maps were reduced to 1024 pixels and
saved as JPEG; normal maps were reduced to 1024 pixels and saved as lossless
PNG; each set's ambient occlusion, roughness and metallic maps were packed
into the red, green and blue channels of a new PNG. The meshes and textures
were exported as a GLB for Godot. The separate bottom magazine and bolt are
animated in code, and the model is posed with separately attributed hands.
The original mesh geometry, UVs and texture colors were not repainted.
ELIZION does not endorse this project.

The original downloaded archive remains locally at
source/stg-44-sturmgewehr.zip and is excluded from Git because it is 176 MB.
The unchanged original high-resolution maps remain locally at
source/original/textures/ and are also excluded from Git. The unchanged
source/original/source/STG44_Full.fbx, the portable working Blender file, all
its converted texture dependencies, and the game GLB are tracked. See
source/SOURCE_MANIFEST.txt for the archive SHA-256 and reconstruction steps.
